section_summary.extract_value: This section details the method of an experiment (referred to as 'Experiment X'), involving 165 female university students. Participants were recruited through a university participation pool and were predominantly white (77.7%), with a mean age of 19.44 years and a mean BMI of 21.31. The experiment used a 2x2 between-subjects design, manipulating appearance vs. health framing and guilt vs. no guilt conditions, with data collected in group testing sessions where participants worked through paper-and-pencil packs.
